title: Implement Cross-Target Reconnect, Stateful Continuity, And Production Gates

parallelization.rationale: This sprint establishes the shared lifecycle and connection-recipe foundation used by every later slice.

groups.title: Shared lifecycle with a real-browser recovery slice

tasks.title: Make ordinary reconnect correct and observable on native and WASM
tasks.action: MUST introduce the single-flight reconnect lifecycle and reusable connection recipe, implement the existing ReconnectionHandler contract on WASM, perform fresh negotiation and handshake outside stateful mode, obey local close and Close allowReconnect, retain callbacks, terminate nonstateful pending work without replay, and prove JSON plus MessagePack recovery through a dedicated WASM fixture driven by repository-local Playwright in real Chromium.
proofObligations: Before implementation, dedicated WASM reconnect tests MUST fail because disconnected/error status has no recovery path and ReconnectionHandler has no methods.
After implementation, native and Chromium WASM ordinary reconnect MUST pass the same automatic/manual/local-close/Close contract in JSON and MessagePack modes.
A fresh reconnect MUST issue a new negotiate and one handshake, retain callbacks, fail pending calls, and send no replayed invocation.
Captured lifecycle diagnostics MUST contain no access_token or Authorization value.

reuse: Existing action storage and callback registrations
allowedAdditions: repository-local Playwright dev tooling and configuration
dedicated browser-facing WASM fixture with bounded diagnostics

red.command: pnpm --dir=tools-node exec playwright test --project=chromium --grep "ordinary reconnect JSON"
red.assertion: The focused Chromium test MUST expose missing WASM ordinary reconnect before production changes.

green.command: pnpm --dir=tools-node exec playwright test --project=chromium --grep "ordinary reconnect JSON"
green.assertion: Chromium JSON MUST recover through fresh negotiation and handshake with correct lifecycle, callback, pending-action, and no-replay behavior.

green.command: pnpm --dir=tools-node exec playwright test --project=chromium --grep "ordinary reconnect MessagePack"
green.assertion: Chromium MessagePack MUST satisfy the same ordinary reconnect contract as JSON.
Transition, cancellation, stale-generation, Close, fresh-negotiate, pending-action, and redaction contracts MUST pass deterministically.

broad.assertion: The affected native library and test targets MUST compile after the lifecycle change.

broadValidation.assertion: The complete WASM all-feature crate MUST compile after ordinary reconnect parity.
Native behavior remains compile-clean across all targets and features.

designQualityFocus: no platform lock or RefCell borrow across await
commitScope: feat(reconnect): add cross-target ordinary reconnect lifecycle

sprints.title: Stateful protocol, buffer, and interop foundation

parallelization.rationale: This sprint creates shared wire, buffer, configuration, fixture, and runner contracts required by both platform runtime slices.

tasks.title: Implement the shared stateful reconnect protocol and deterministic harness
tasks.action: MUST add explicit stateful configuration and negotiate capability, exact JSON and MessagePack Ack/Sequence codecs, the bounded serialized StatefulMessageBuffer with backpressure and duplicate suppression, shared action continuity rules, stateful .NET endpoints, and a validated local interop runner ready for native and WASM scenario tasks.
proofObligations: Golden protocol tests MUST fail before MessageType 8/9 and exact codecs exist.
Buffer model tests MUST cover every transition, capacity boundary, race, duplicate, gap, overflow, and terminal cleanup contract.
Stateful opt-in MUST be absent by default and capability fallback MUST retain ordinary reconnect.
The runner MUST reject invalid selectors and clean up a deliberately failing fixture run before platform scenarios use it.

allowedAdditions: test-service stateful endpoint and synthetic sequence methods

red.assertion: Golden frame tests MUST expose the missing Ack and Sequence protocol before implementation.

green.assertion: JSON negotiation, codec, buffer, backpressure, duplicate, gap, overflow, disposal, and compatibility tests MUST pass.
MessagePack golden frames and shared stateful behavior MUST pass with the same logical assertions as JSON.
The JSON and MessagePack wire contract plus opt-in compatibility surface MUST pass together.
Runner selector validation, service health timeout, deliberate failure propagation, redaction, and finally cleanup MUST pass.

broad.assertion: The ordinary and stateful ASP.NET Core fixture endpoints MUST compile.

broadValidation.assertion: Shared stateful protocol changes MUST compile across native targets and features.
The shared stateful protocol and buffer MUST compile for WASM with MessagePack.

commitScope: feat(protocol): add stateful reconnect Ack Sequence foundation

parallelization.rationale: After Sprint 2, native stateful behavior is a complete vertical slice confined to native adapter/tests and can overlap the disjoint WASM slice only with explicit user authorization.

groups.title: Native same-token resume and exactly-once proof

tasks.title: Complete native stateful reconnect runtime behavior
tasks.action: MUST integrate the shared stateful buffer and reconnect coordinator with the Tokio WebSocket adapter, resume the same negotiated transport without handshake, preserve valid in-flight actions, and pass three-drop JSON and MessagePack runtime scenarios against ASP.NET Core.
proofObligations: The native stateful scenario MUST fail before the adapter reopens the physical socket without another handshake and invokes ordered resend.
JSON and MessagePack MUST each survive three drops with one logical connection and exactly-once callback/stream observations.
Pending invocation and stream actions MUST remain live through stateful resume and complete normally.
Stale receive generations and duplicate replay frames MUST not reach application dispatch.

prohibitedAdditions: changes to shared protocol or WASM adapter
allowedAdditions: focused native JSON and MessagePack scenarios

red.assertion: The native stateful scenario MUST expose the missing same-token resume integration before implementation.

green.assertion: Native JSON MUST survive three physical drops with one logical connection, no second handshake, exactly-once order, and valid in-flight completion.
Native MessagePack MUST satisfy the exact same three-drop stateful assertions as JSON.

broad.assertion: All native targets and features MUST compile after Tokio stateful integration.

broadValidation.assertion: The complete native ordinary/stateful JSON/MessagePack matrix MUST pass as one checkpoint.

parallelization.rationale: After Sprint 2, browser stateful behavior is a complete vertical slice confined to WASM adapter/tests and can overlap the disjoint native slice only with explicit user authorization.

groups.title: Browser same-token resume and exactly-once proof

tasks.title: Complete WASM stateful reconnect runtime behavior
tasks.action: MUST integrate the shared stateful buffer and reconnect coordinator with the WASM polling adapter, use browser-safe timers and generation guards, resume the same negotiated WebSocket without handshake, preserve valid in-flight actions, and pass three-drop JSON and MessagePack scenarios in real Chromium.
proofObligations: The browser stateful scenario MUST fail before WASM can resume the same transport and sequence replay.
JSON and MessagePack MUST each survive three real Chromium WebSocket drops with exactly-once ordered application observations.
No RefCell borrow MUST cross await/user-callback boundaries and all interval/timeout handles MUST be cancelled at terminal close.
Pending invocation and stream actions MUST complete after stateful resume rather than being lost or duplicated.

prohibitedAdditions: browser automation framework other than the established repository-local Playwright harness
changes to shared protocol or native adapter
allowedAdditions: focused Chromium JSON and MessagePack scenarios

red.assertion: The browser stateful scenario MUST expose the missing WASM resume integration before implementation.

green.assertion: Chromium JSON MUST survive three physical drops with one logical connection, no second handshake, exactly-once order, and valid in-flight completion.
Chromium MessagePack MUST satisfy the same three-drop stateful assertions as JSON and native.

broad.assertion: The full WASM MessagePack target MUST compile after stateful integration.

broadValidation.assertion: The complete Chromium ordinary/stateful JSON/MessagePack matrix MUST pass as one checkpoint.

sprints.title: Zero-warning baseline and production CI convergence

parallelization.rationale: Repository-wide formatting/lint cleanup and workflow convergence touch all prior slices and must run after both platform checkpoints.

tasks.title: Establish a reproducible zero-warning Rust baseline
tasks.action: MUST apply repository-wide rustfmt, resolve every compiler, Clippy, and rustdoc warning without broad allow attributes or behavior changes, declare Rust 1.92 compatibility and the pinned toolchain components/target, and keep the complete reconnect matrix passing.
proofObligations: Capture the measured rustfmt and Clippy failing baseline before edits.
After cleanup, rustfmt, native/WASM compiler checks, Clippy -D warnings, and rustdoc -D warnings MUST all exit zero.
No broad allow attribute, disabled lint, reduced target/feature set, or removed test MUST create the green result.
The native and Chromium ordinary/stateful JSON/MessagePack matrix MUST remain behaviorally unchanged.

prohibitedAdditions: behavior change without new red-green contract
allowedAdditions: rust-toolchain.toml with rustfmt clippy wasm32 target
narrow documented lint allow only when semantic behavior requires it and task reconciliation records it

red.assertion: The planning baseline MUST reproduce inherited formatting differences before cleanup.
The planning baseline MUST reproduce inherited Clippy failures before cleanup.

green.assertion: The repository MUST have zero rustfmt differences.
Native library and test targets MUST have zero compiler or Clippy warnings.
WASM all-feature compilation MUST emit zero warnings.

broad.assertion: Public documentation MUST build with warnings denied.

groups.title: Required-check workflows and final production matrix

tasks.title: Add and prove production GitHub Actions gates
tasks.action: MUST add least-privilege quality and interoperability workflows, exact local workflow-verification and security commands, native OS plus WASM matrices, real Chromium JSON/MessagePack reconnect jobs, failure-only redacted artifacts, and documentation of stable check names and local reproduction without enabling publishing or changing GitHub settings.
proofObligations: Before workflow creation, the verifier MUST fail because named workflows, permissions, triggers, matrices, timeouts, cleanup, security, and artifact contracts are absent.
Every command referenced by quality.yml and interop.yml MUST be executable from a clean local checkout through the documented route.
The final native/WASM JSON/MessagePack ordinary/stateful matrix MUST pass with 60-second per-scenario bounds and zero leaked processes.
Workflow files MUST define contents-read permissions, PR concurrency cancellation, no secret requirement, vulnerability gates, and failure-only redacted artifacts.

red.assertion: The workflow contract verifier MUST expose the absent production gates before implementation.

green.assertion: Workflow triggers, permissions, concurrency, toolchains, matrices, timeouts, cleanup, security, failure artifacts, and local-command parity MUST match the frozen contract.
All eight target/protocol/scenario cells MUST pass with required timeouts, exactly-once assertions, and cleanup.
Least permissions, credential redaction, RustSec, NuGet transitive scan, and failure-only artifact contracts MUST pass.

broad.assertion: The verifier MUST execute the frozen local quality commands and all MUST pass with warnings denied.

broadValidation.assertion: The complete production quality and security command set MUST pass locally with the same contract as CI.
The complete production runtime matrix MUST pass before the epic can close.

commitScope: ci: add production quality and interop gates
